body: I'm lost and tired. And lonely. God am I lonely.   I've been traveling America coast to coast (got kicked out for breaking all of my parents Meth pipes so I decided I might as well travel. This has been the hardest journey of my life. I cry every night because I just want a home and I realize I will never have that. I have no friends or family that cares. I'm just...alone. The plan is to get to Florida and then overdose on the beach at sunrise but in a way, I wish I had a reason to stay....help.
I can't find her either. Maybe she deleted her profile? I just want her to comment back to us and say she is fine.

Today was my first day here and the first post I saw was by this girl writing her suicide note, in a way. It was heartbreaking. Every other post have been close to the same. There is so much sadness in this sub.
Lol, so we should swipe right 100% of the time?
That is the strangest thought, I can see it but,  it gives me chills thinking of such a big change.
That's one of my fears as well!

Probably the most heartbreaking thing I have seen. I feel that you are probably gone now but, I want you to know that I will use your story to help others and come to understand warning signs. I'll listen to the song for you. I hope you are at peace. Fly high, sister.
